subject: Trial engagement playbook & onboarding nudge
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novanta.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + proposed trial engagement playbook

Hi Elena — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed lightweight playbook so we can keep momentum on the 4-week proof-of-concept (POC):

High-level goal (your ask):
- Validate Redwood inference integration for real-time user-facing summaries with sub-500ms tail latency and <8% hallucination rate on your internal test prompts.

Proposed success criteria (confirm if agreeable):
1) Latency: p95 <500ms on 512-token window with your sample traffic profile.
2) Quality: automated evals against your 300 prompt set show <=8% major-regression (false facts) and >=85% acceptable ratings by reviewers.
3) Stability: 48-hour sustained throughput run with no more than 2% error rate.

Suggested timeline (fast, 4-week playbook):
- Week 0 (this week): contract/NDAs + security questionnaire exchange.
- Week 1: infra onboarding + data/secret access (test keys, S3 samples) + install test harness.
- Week 2: baseline runs, model tuning & config (quantization/batching), begin automated evals.
- Week 3: run edge cases, human review, quality adjustments.
- Week 4: final acceptance run, handoff notes + SOW for production.

Ownership (proposed):
- Novanta: Elena (product owner), Jake (procurement).
- Redwood: Lauren (AE, program lead), Marissa (CSM, onboarding), Rafael (SE, tech lead).

Open asks / next steps from our side:
- Elena: confirm success criteria above and any legal/ procurement timing constraints.
- Jake/Procurement: confirm PO timeline or if you prefer a pilot MSA/POC addendum.
- Novanta infra: provide a 24-hour sample trace and a small S3 bucket with representative docs (non-PHI).

Attachments: I attached a first-draft trial-playbook for your review (trial-plan-draft.pdf).

If that looks good, I’ll send calendar invites for the 1:1 onboarding session with Rafael and Marissa next Tuesday.

Thanks — excited to get this rolling.

—
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novanta.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Turner <jake.turner@novanta.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed trial engagement playbook

Lauren — thanks for the clear recap and the draft playbook. Quick responses:

- Success criteria: agreed on the three buckets. For quality, we’ll add a manual review pass where our SMEs tag any "major regression" examples — I can send the rubric. The 300-prompt set is fine.
- Timeline: procurement is the gating factor. We can do a 4-week POC but procurement needs a signed NDA and a short MSA addendum; Jake here is copied (he’ll follow up with timing). If procurement needs signatures, we can probably start infra onboarding while legal reviews.
- Data: our infra team will provide a 48-hour sample trace and an S3 path with sanitized documents by Monday EOD.

One addition to success criteria: business metric — 10% reduction in downstream summarization rework (estimated based on our baseline) during the POC evaluation window. If we hit the quality goals and show measurable rework reduction, that’ll speed up approval.

Looking forward to the onboarding session. Tell Rafael we’ll share a small auth token with restricted scope for the sandbox.

Regards,
Elena
VP Product, Novanta

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Elena Gomez <elena.gomez@novanta.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + proposed trial engagement playbook — onboarding checklist + links

Hi all — looping in the onboarding checklist and next items from CSM side. See items below; I’ll own the cadence and weekly check-ins.

Onboarding checklist (Marissa / CSM):
- Share calendar invite: 60-min Tech Onboard w/ Rafael + Novanta infra (I propose Tue 11/03 10:00 PST).
- Provide sandbox keys: Novanta to provide restricted auth token (Elena said this is coming).
- Baseline dataset: Novanta to place sample files in S3 path and share read-only creds.
- Security review: I attached a short security appendix for the POC (security-appendix.pdf). Please flag anything sensitive.
- Acceptance rubric: Elena — please send the SME rubric when convenient.

DocuSign / procurement: I’ll attach the pilot addendum template to this thread and send a DocuSign link once procurement confirms recipients.

Calendar invites: Sending invites now for the onboarding call and a weekly 30-min sync (Thursdays) to keep the runbooks moving.

—
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Quick tech note:
- I’ve reviewed the sample manifest schema Elena mentioned and I can build a small harness for automatic eval runs. I’ll need:
  * a single S3 prefix with ~300 sample prompts + expected outputs (even if noisy),
  * one example of your current summary output for manual comparison, and
  * a short JSON mapping for request/response fields.

I’ll have the harness ready to run baseline tests within 48 hours of receiving the S3 access.

-Rafael
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Status snapshot:
- Procurement: Elena/Jake — legal review in progress per your note; please advise if DocuSign recipients change.
- Sandbox/data: Elena — you mentioned S3 path by Monday; we didn’t receive it yet. Can you confirm ETA?
- Onboarding call: Marissa has sent invites for Tue 11/03 and weekly Thurs syncs; Rafael is set for the tech session.
- Trial artifacts: I uploaded the trial-playbook draft and security appendix to the DocuSign link (see thread).

Immediate asks (one-line replies appreciated):
- Elena: please confirm S3 path + restricted token ETA.
- Jake / Procurement: confirm whether MSA addendum or PO is preferred for pilot sign-off and estimated sign date.
- Marissa: confirm the onboarding call time worked OK and note any reschedules.
- Rafael: any blockers on your side for baseline harness?

If I don’t hear back by EOD Friday PST, I’ll follow up with a short calendar hold for the onboarding tasks so we keep the four-week window intact. Small asks only — thank you.
